data.desc: Actuate is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for the treatment of high-impact, difficult-to-treat cancers. Actuate's lead investigational drug, elraglusib (a novel GSK-3 inhibitor), targets molecular pathways in cancer that are involved in activation of anti-tumor immunity through the regulation of multiple immune checkpoints and immune cell function in addition to targeting those promoting tumor growth and resistance to conventional chemotherapy.
